2.key: We've covered a lot of ground … have yet to be felt
2.heard: We've covered a lot of ground and the full effects of our tightening have yet to be felt.
2.ko: 우리는 많이 왔고, 긴축의 효과는 아직 다 나타나지 않았습니다.

2.key: today we decided to leave … policy interest rate unchanged
2.heard: today we decided to leave our policy interest rate unchanged
2.ko: 그래서 오늘, 정책금리를 그대로 두기로 했습니다.

4.key: considering how far and how fast … implications for monetary policy
4.heard: considering how far and how fast we've moved, we judged it prudent to hold the target range steady to allow the committee to assess additional information and its implications for monetary policy.
4.ko: 얼마나 멀리, 얼마나 빨리 왔는지를 생각하면, 금리를 그대로 두는 게 신중하다고 판단했습니다. 새로 나오는 정보를 보고 그 의미를 따져 보려는 겁니다.

6.key: nearly all committee participants view it as likely … appropriate this year
6.heard: nearly all committee participants view it as likely that some further rate increases will be appropriate this year
6.ko: 거의 모든 위원이, 올해 안에 금리를 조금 더 올리는 게 적절할 것으로 봅니다.
